summary: Maintenance verification: no repository updates; desktop preference requires reconciliation
changes: No operational changes. Package inventory, selected configuration hashes, display-manager selection, trusted package-signature policy and protected administrator-directory mode remained unchanged. Private audit records, an isolated update-query database and a sanitized receipt were created.
tests: ChatGPT login status succeeded. Isolated checkupdates returned 2 with no output. Package database check passed. File-presence checks passed for both kernels, Mesa, systemd, ChatGPT, Steam and Intel/AMD Vulkan packages for both architectures. No failed system units. Maintenance timer enabled at thirty-minute intervals; service execution timeout remains unlimited. No graphical, gaming, benchmark or model execution tests performed.
rollback: No operational change to revert. Preserve audit records and do not undo changes made by other sessions. Existing manual service and timer stop mechanisms remain available.
problem: The maintenance prompt requests KDE Plasma and SDDM, while recent package transactions removed them after installing XFCE and LightDM. LightDM is currently active. The source and intent of that desktop change are unconfirmed.
solution: Preserved current state and recorded a local proposal to confirm the desired desktop during the next interactive session before reconciling configuration or maintenance instructions.
reproduction: Local package history and current package inventory show the desktop transition; systemd identifies LightDM as the active display manager. No upstream defect or tested upstream fix established.
